hero.description: A sacred space of restoration, prophetic writings, dream interpretation, spiritual discernment, and kingdom-centered creativity. Through books, scrolls, reflections, teachings, and revelations, The Rib Restored exists to help others understand the language of dreams, navigate spiritual encounters with wisdom, and rediscover identity, healing, and purpose through a grounded scriptural lens.

bioParagraphs: Shalaymah Nurrayah Tzeduqah, known as <highlight>The Rib Restored</highlight>, is a prophetic dreamer, writer, seer, creative visionary, and spiritual teacher dedicated to helping others understand dreams, discernment, symbolism, restoration, and spiritual revelation through wisdom, beauty, and scriptural grounding.

Through prophetic writings, teachings, reflections, books, and the mission of <highlight>Beit YHWH HaGo'el</highlight>, she creates spaces where restoration, healing, identity, spiritual maturity, and revelation meet — guiding others to recognize the voice of Elohim with clarity, humility, discernment, and purpose.
